text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 209 tablets of divalproex sodium 500 mg, providing 25.7 days of supply at the current usage rate of 8.1 tablets per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include divalproex sodium as of 2026-10-21. The repack plant for our current NDC (67046164703) is Coupler LLC (FEI 3003734940). FDA inspection records for Coupler LLC show OAI classifications on 2018-04-27, 2020-03-10, and 2021-08-12, with a Warning Letter issued on 2020-09-15. The most recent inspection on 2026-03-02 was classified VAI.

Our position: The drug is not on the FDA shortage list. Current inventory covers approximately 26 days. The repack plant has a history of OAI classifications and a Warning Letter, though the latest inspection was VAI. Alternate manufacturers are not on the shortage list, but their labels do not identify plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify current allocation status and lead times with Atlantic Biologicals Corp.; requires P&T Committee approval to add as a vendor.
2. Buyer to verify allocation status and lead times with AbbVie Inc.; requires P&T Committee approval to add as a vendor.
3. Buyer to verify allocation status and lead times with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC; requires P&T Committee approval to add as a vendor.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA inspection updates for Coupler LLC (FEI 3003734940); requires no additional approval.
5. Buyer to report supply status to P&T Committee at next scheduled meeting; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Initiating a formal shortage protocol or therapeutic interchange at this time because the drug is not listed on the FDA shortage list and current inventory exceeds three weeks.
